svg.text: DESIGN_Terrain_Editor_UX.md · A toolbar + sticky tools · B trees · C walls, snapping, gates · D obstacles · E Details · F handles. Annotations in grey are not drawn by the app.
A One door for every terrain tool — the Tools toolbar's Terrain row (TE-1), and a tool that stays armed (TE-2)
each button shows its LAST variant (Hedge = the wall family); its arrow opens the family —
the SAME picks Add Entity lists (TerrainPickCatalog), never a second list
Hedge — 3 drawn · click the first point of the next
Esc or Select stops the tool · the toolbar keeps it lit
TE-2: a line / area terrain tool re-arms after Finish,
as point placement already does (always-multi, D5)
B Planting trees — one, a row, a group (TE-3); a row and a group are ONE feature each (TE-4)

g.text: ① one tree — click
Row of 16 trees · 8 m apart · 124 m
kept off the road edge (2 m) · Enter ends
② a row — drag along a line
③ a group — draw an area: 11 lone trees

svg.text: Tree — drag a line to plant a row
= one tree every 8 m along the line
16 lone trees · they fell, burn and block like any lone tree (B-6)
Group: count 11 · Row and Group are ONE entity each (one undo, one Details)
⚠ not a WOOD: a wood is a canopy mass (density per ha, sight blocked inside);
a row / a group is single trunks — what a user means by "plant trees here"
TE-4: Row and Group are the scatter feature with a LINE or an AREA shape and
ONE item type (here: tree) — the same kind serves obstacle rows (D)
C A wall along a road, a wall round a plot, a gate — snapping (TE-6) and the gate split (TE-7)

g.text: road edge +1 m
Wall 320 m · brick 2 m · snapped to the road edge (+1 m)
Alt: no snap · Shift: 15° steps · Enter ends
Add gate here (3 m)
Insert point
Finish
Enter
a wall round a plot: Wall around a plot = a CLOSED line;
a gate = the segment's menu in Edit Shape — it SPLITS the wall
into two features with a 3 m gap (one undo step; no new data)
joins Hedge 2

svg.text: Snapping while drawing a terrain line or area
a line runs along the edge at an offset
a wall meets a house without a gap
a new hedge continues an old one
TE-6 extends Map Interaction's snap row (§2.5, R-4134: ground · grid · 15°)
with three TERRAIN targets; road edges and line ends are ON for terrain
lines (the jobs are "along this road", "continue that hedge") — a deviation
from the units' off-default, said; Alt suspends every snap for one point
D Obstacles — one, or a row along a line (TE-5); street clutter in an area (the scatter's first recipes ship)

g.text: Sandbags · a row, end to end (spacing 0)
4 concrete blocks · 1.5 m gaps · the road is CLOSED to vehicles
infantry passes · SUMO re-routes (P-2) · Enter ends
Street clutter · Normal · 14 items · seed 3434

svg.text: Obstacle — click one, or drag a line for a row
a row across a road closes it to vehicles (P-2 road blockage)
E One Details tab for every feature (TE-8)
320 m · 2 gates · stops every vehicle; a tank breaks it (B-3) · blasts breach it (B-2)
Edit Shape (E) · Add gate · Split here
F What you placed stays visible and pickable (TE-9); the ghost while drawing (TE-10)

g.text: a placed tree: a handle dot, picked by a click
a row: selected as ONE (its outline), before the bake lands too
the ghost: the wall the bake WILL make, in its own colour
